events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released in the UK
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975. The album of the same name was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released in the UK. A song that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: The revolutionary first-generation iPod was unveiled by Apple on this day in 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'. It officially went on sale on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the day music changed forever? 25 years ago today, Apple unveiled the very first iPod. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on this date, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and his incredible 64-year cinematic legacy. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon, who was born in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring spirit of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is truly unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968 in the UK.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A bold, experimental journey that redefined the band. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the extraordinary talent and unforgettable stage presence of Freddie Mercury. His voice lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965 in the UK, marking a significant artistic evolution for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced generations.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the tragic 46th anniversary of the death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his incredible legacy that continues to inspire peace and love worldwide.
